title: Intimation of loss
text:
157. Intimation of loss.—When, in the course of the assessment of the total income of any assessee,

it is established that a loss has taken place which the assessee is entitled to have carried forward and set
off under the provisions of sub-section (1) of section 72, sub-section (2) of section 73, [ [sub-section (1)
[or sub-section (3) of section 74] or sub-section (3) of section 74A], the [Assessing Officer] shall notify to](javascript:ShowMainContent('Act',%20'CMSID',%20'102120000000063886',%20'');)
the assessee by an order in writing the amount of the loss as computed by him for the purposes of
sub-section (1) of section 72, sub-section (2) of section 73, [[sub-section (1) or sub-section (3) of
section 74] or sub-section (3) of section 74A].
